sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Professional - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Here's a little truth for you: serious money and a reputation don't come just from showing up to the top matches. No solid results, no solid cash. So come on, get moving."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Win a match claiming at least 4th place in the team in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
